title: moduleType
description: JSON document describing a new moduleType

version.description: Version number of the template. Minor version must be increased with every change. Major version must only be changed when targeting a different API version.

id.description: Id of the module type. Consists of id of manufacturer followed by id of module type. See documentation for rules.

name.description: Name of the module as given by manufacturer

manufacturerId.description: Id of the manufacturer of the device type.

orderCode.description: Order code for the device type as used by the manufacturer.

orderNumber.description: Order number for the device type as used by the manufacturer.

spanWidth.description: The width of the module in slots

portTypes.description: List of all types of ports on the device type.

name.description: Name of the port, as printed on the device.

subinterfaceTypes.description: List of all subinterfaceTypes included in the portType

name.description: The name of the subinterfaceType. Left null if only one subinterface exists on the port. Else a descriptive name, like Ch. 1, GPI IN 3, etc.

direction.description: Direction of the subinterFaceType. See documentation for explainations of the possible values.

compatibleSignalTypes.description: List of signal types that are compatible with this port.

pinout.description: An array describing the pins asscociated with the subinterface.

pin.description: A human readable identification of the pin, e.g. its number or center/shield for BNC.

signal.description: The signal present on that pin. This is not the signalType, but something more basic like positive, negative, GND, etc.

moduleSlotTypes.description: List of all types of module slots on the module type.

name.description: Name of the module slot, as labeled on the module.

canSpan.description: Indicates wether a module can span into the next slot

compatibleModuleSlotFormFactors.description: List of module slot factors that can physically fit into the slot.

compatibleModuleTypes.description: List of module types that are guranteed by the manufacturer to work in this slot.

incompatibleModuleTypes.description: List of module types that are guranteed by the manufacturer not work in this module slot.
